strings.Welcher Umsatz zählt für die Stufen 1 bi: Which revenue counts for tiers 1 to 6?
strings.Für die Stufen 1 bis 6 zählt der Vorjahr: For tiers 1 to 6, the previous year's revenue from short-term rentals counts: for your own properties the rental income; for properties you manage for others your own fees, commissions and service charges (excluding the owners' pass-through rental income); for service providers and platforms the revenue from products and services for short-term rentals. For international companies, worldwide revenue from this business area counts. You declare the revenue yourself, on joining and then by 31 January. The board may ask for proof.
strings.Der Beitrag gilt für das Kalenderjahr. E: The fee covers the calendar year. It is due by 31 March. If you join during the year, it is calculated pro rata by month and is due 30 days after your membership is confirmed. Fees already paid are not refunded on withdrawal or exclusion.
strings.Alle Mitglieder haben Stimmrecht an der: All members have voting rights at the general assembly. There is a single fee table: hosts, property managers and service providers are not distinguished.
